rules.text: The document title must be "Software Requirements Specification".
The first page must show the version number in the form "Version X.Y".
The first page must show the author's name with the label "Author:".
The date on the first page must be written as DD.MM.YYYY.
The document must contain an "Introduction" section.
The document must contain a "Scope" section.
The document must contain a "Glossary" section.
Every requirement must carry an identifier of the form FR-N.
Every use case must carry an identifier of the form UC-N.M.
Requirements must not use optional wording such as "can" or "may".
Vague terms ("appropriate", "if needed", "etc.") must not be used.
A password must be at least 8 characters long.
The session timeout must be 15 minutes.
The system response time must be at most 3 seconds.
Every use case must have a Priority field with the value High, Medium or Low.
Every screenshot must carry a numbered caption of the form "Figure N".
Tables must be numbered with "Table N".
Quality requirements must carry an identifier of the form QR-X.N.
Passwords must not be stored in plain text.
Monetary amounts must be shown in euros (€).
The document must end with an "Appendices" section.
Every requirement must be traceable to at least one use case (UC).
The document must contain a revision history table.
The term "customer" must not be used; the term "user" must be used.
Every page must show the page number at the bottom in the form "Page N".

comments.text: The version number format is wrong; it should read 'Version 2.0'.
The password is 6 characters; it must be at least 8.
The title should be translated to German.
FR-4 refers to UC-9.9 but no such use case exists.
The session timeout should be 15 minutes.
The glossary should also define the term 'customer'.
Fees should be shown in USD instead of euros.
The response time should be 1 second.
